alt: A downward-opening parabola drawn in the xy-plane, crossing the x-axis at two labelled points, meeting the y-axis at a marked point, and with its vertex labelled (h, k).

An xy-plane showing a downward-opening parabola that meets the x-axis at the origin and at one labelled point, together with a straight line drawn through the parabola's labelled vertex and that x-intercept; the y-axis carries numbered tick marks.

An xy-plane with a light rectangular grid showing a steeply rising cubic curve; two points on the curve are marked with dots, labelled with their coordinates, and joined to the y-axis by dashed horizontal leader lines.

An xy-plane with numbered tick marks on both axes showing an upward-opening parabola labelled y = x squared and a straight line labelled y = mx minus 1 that touches the parabola at a single marked point.

An xy-plane with numbered tick marks on both axes showing an upward-opening parabola labelled y = x squared and a straight line labelled y = mx minus 1 that touches the parabola at a single marked point.
An xy-plane with a light square grid and numbered tick marks, showing a smooth polynomial curve that rises to a maximum, falls, levels off near the x-axis and then falls again.
An xy-plane with the origin labelled O and no tick marks, showing an upward-opening parabola.

A plane diagram of two nested right triangles sharing a common vertex: a horizontal base line with two labelled points on it, two vertical segments rising from those points with their right angles marked, and a slanted line through the tops of both.
A square unit grid in the xy-plane with numbered axes and three plotted points.
A line diagram: two parallel vertical lines labelled a and b crossed by three slanted lines labelled c, d and e, with five of the angles formed marked by letters.
A circle with four labelled points on it; two chords are drawn inside the circle, crossing at a labelled interior point, with right-angle marks at two of the vertices.
A right triangle with its three vertices labelled, the right angle marked with a small square, and the hypotenuse labelled with its length.
Two straight segments crossing at a labelled interior point, forming two triangles that point in opposite directions; all five points are labelled.

A plane diagram with a horizontal base line carrying three labelled points, a slanted line from the left-hand end rising to a labelled point above, and two further segments drawn across the interior; one angle is marked with a letter.
An xy-plane with a square unit grid and numbered axes; a horizontal dashed line is drawn and the half-plane on one side of it is shaded.
An xy-plane with a square unit grid and numbered axes; a horizontal dashed line is drawn and the half-plane on one side of it is shaded.
An xy-plane with a square unit grid and numbered axes; a solid slanted line is drawn through two marked points and the half-plane on one side of it is shaded.
An xy-plane with a square unit grid and numbered axes; a solid slanted line is drawn through two marked points and the half-plane on one side of it is shaded.
An xy-plane with a square unit grid and numbered axes; a solid slanted line is drawn through two marked points and the half-plane on one side of it is shaded.
An xy-plane with a rectangular grid and numbered axes showing the graph of a cubic curve that rises to a local maximum, falls to a local minimum and then rises steeply.
A circle with four labelled points on it; two chords are drawn inside the circle, crossing at a labelled interior point, with right-angle marks at two of the vertices.

A plane diagram: a rectangle with its four corners labelled, two extra labelled points on the lower side, right-angle marks at the two lower corners, and two slanted segments drawn across the interior that cross at a labelled point.
note: Recorded spec is incomplete rather than wrong: the printed page also draws segment AC across the top and segment GD along the bottom, so the figure is a rectangle AGDC with AE and CF crossing inside it, not two free-standing triangles. Built from the page.
